Type:        EXT_MERGE_JOIN
Name:        ExtMergeJoin
Category:    joiners
Description: Receives sorted data through all connected input ports, for each join key value contained in data records incoming through the first input port (drivers) searches corresponding data records incoming through the other port(s) (slaves) with the same key value. Every combination of driver and its corresponding slaves is sent to transformation class that joins them to form outgoing data flow. Resulting records are sent to connected output port.
Usage:       When to use: Equality join. Both driver and slave are already sorted on the join key (or you're adding EXT_SORT upstream anyway). More memory-efficient than EXT_HASH_JOIN for large slaves.
             Constraints: BOTH inputs MUST be pre-sorted on join key — add EXT_SORT or FAST_SORT upstream if not.
             Use EXT_HASH_JOIN if inputs are unsorted and slave fits in memory.

Input Ports:
  [0] driver (required)
  [*] slave (min 1 required)
Output Ports:
  [0] (required)
  [1] (optional)

Properties:
  Conditional required groups:
    transform | transformClass | transformURL (at least one is required; mutually exclusive)

  Always required:
    joinKey

  joinKey: [mergeJoinKey] (REQUIRED)  Defines the fields used to join data from multiple input sources.
  joinType: [enum]  (default: Inner join)  Specifies the type of join operation to perform (inner, left outer, full outer).
    values: inner, leftOuter, fullOuter
  transform [attr-cdata]: [transform]  Defines the transformation logic used to convert input records to output records.
  transformURL: [file]  Specifies the path to an external file containing the transformation logic.
  transformClass: [class]  Specifies the Java class that implements the transformation logic.
  locale: [locale]  (default: none)  Specifies the locale used for string comparison and sorting operations.
  caseSensitive: [bool]  (default: false)  Controls whether string comparisons are case-sensitive.
  errorActions [attr-cdata]: [errorActions]  Defines the actions to take when errors occur during processing.
  errorLog: [file]  Specifies the file where error information should be logged.
  charset: [charset]  Defines the character encoding used to encode/decode file content. If not specified, the system will attempt to detect or use the default encoding.
  slaveDuplicates: [bool]  (default: true)  Controls whether duplicate records in slave inputs are allowed during join operations.
  ascendingInputs: [bool]  (default: true)  When enabled, controls ascending ordering of inputs of the component.
  leftOuterJoin: [bool]  When enabled, performs a left outer join operation.
  fullOuterJoin: [bool]  When enabled, performs a full outer join operation.

To configure it, call component_get_guide("EXT_MERGE_JOIN") — full attribute reference with allowed values, defaults, and worked mapping/transform examples this surface view omits. Don't re-run component_get_info on the same type; if the properties above aren't enough, escalate to component_get_guide.
